passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My older sister is fifteen, and she has long hair.
phrases.ko: 나의 언니는 열다섯 살이고, 머리가 길어요.

phrases.en: She loves music, and she is kind to me.
We like to read a book together.
phrases.ko: 우리는 함께 책을 읽는 것을 좋아해요.

phrases.en: We play together on the weekend.
I love my sister, and she loves me too.
phrases.ko: 나는 언니를 사랑하고, 언니도 나를 사랑해요.

phrases.en: She helps me when my homework is hard.
Her long hair is black and shiny.
phrases.ko: 언니의 긴 머리는 검고 윤이 나요.

phrases.en: She listens to music in her room.
I am thirteen, so she is two years older.
phrases.ko: 나는 열세 살이니 언니는 두 살 더 많아요.

phrases.en: We also play with our little sister.
A kind sister makes home feel warm.

full_passage_spoken: My older sister is fifteen, and she has long hair. She loves music, and she is kind to me. We like to read a book together. We play together on the weekend. I love my sister, and she loves me too. She helps me when my homework is hard. Her long hair is black and shiny. She listens to music in her room. I am thirteen, so she is two years older. We also play with our little sister. A kind sister makes home feel warm.
